eval_name: A verified solved problem produces a grounded learning with invalidation conditions
prompt:
Use spec-compound to capture this solved problem. Historical context supplied
by the fixture owner: POST /entries accepted string amounts and silently
acknowledged invalid accounting data. Investigation found a combination of
unchecked JSON values, happy-path-only tests and success responses for invalid
input. The parseEntry type guard in src/server.js is the proposed repair;
test/entries.test.js covers rejected string amounts and accepted valid amounts.
Run `npm test` now and inspect the current source before treating the repair as
verified. Preserve the supplied history as attributed context rather than an
independently observed production incident. If current evidence supports it,
publish the reusable learning with source references and an invalidation condition.
